A '''neural chipset''' was an advanced type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] brain. The engineer [[Loramarr]] designed a [[quad-photonic neural chipset]] for a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was kept by the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
